candidates.title: Two blend RPCs inline idempotency INSERT instead of hardened save_idempotency
candidates.reason: Real consistency gap (SYSTEMIC): multiple RPCs inline their idempotency INSERT (ON CONFLICT(idempotency_key) DO NOTHING or plain INSERT) instead of calling save_idempotency, bypassing its cross-op guard (added by prior-hunt PARKED-008, which explicitly noted direct callers remain unfixed). Known instances: reverse_blend_ticket_approval, create_invoice_from_blend_ticket, dismiss_watchdog_flag (C23, cycle 7), start_job, complete_job. Only matters under a UUID cross-op collision (effectively impossible) -> optional defense-in-depth migration sweep.

candidates.title: apply_prepay_to_invoice guards CURRENT_DATE not invoice_date
candidates.reason: NOT A BUG. A prepay application is a present-dated event (no historical date param); CURRENT_DATE is the correct, consistent guard — it sits alongside apply_write_off(CURRENT_DATE) and issue_return_credit(CURRENT_DATE). Invoice-dated events (post/void/unpost_invoice) guard invoice_date; today-dated events guard CURRENT_DATE. Guarding the old invoice's period would wrongly forbid applying prepay to any invoice whose original period closed.

candidates.title: Prepay Quick/Apply-All buttons call hard-disabled RPCs (always error)

candidates.title: Quote convert pre-saves 'accepted' before convert_quote_to_order
candidates.reason: Headline refuted. The destructive partial-draw case is already guarded (handler checks quote_product_draws and routes away BEFORE the pre-save). convert_quote_to_order is DESIGNED to tolerate a pre-flipped 'accepted' (accepts sent/revised/accepted; releases holds itself atomically). Residual LOW: a non-drawn convert FAILURE after the pre-save leaves holds released + quote reverted to sent without hold recreation — but it's a deliberate, heavily-commented flow with a graceful catch; not a safe autonomous edit. Noted, not fixed.

candidates.title: total_planned_qty double-counts planned quote demand (holds_qty + planned_qty)
candidates.reason: Confirmed: _sync_planned_holds creates a crop_program hold of qty (total_units_needed - drawn) for each planned quote item, so the planned demand is in holds_qty; the planned_quotes CTE counts SUM(total_units_needed) for the same quotes; UI sums holds_qty + planned_qty -> double-count (and planned_qty is also stale: it ignores draws). Robust fix is RPC-level (drop/redefine planned_qty so it excludes what holds already cover); interim frontend fix = total_planned_qty: holds_qty.

candidates.title: PO submit is a direct status UPDATE, not an RPC
candidates.reason: Adequately gated: po_update RLS is admin-only; enforce_po_status_transition trigger validates the state machine on any update; trg_po_submitted_on_order handles the On-Order side-effect. The real exploitable gap was a specific careless caller (JobDetail) -> fixed as C22. Optional edge-fn hardening (require a key) noted but not pursued.
